text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"SHORE HARDNESS- 80±5"}],"comment":"Note N2 specifies Shore hardness but does not state the durometer scale (e.g., Shore A or Shore D), which is essential for a polyurethane part because the scales measure entirely different stiffness ranges. The designer should amend N2 to include the scale, such as 'SHORE HARDNESS- 80±5 SHORE A'.","recommended_correction":"Update note N2 to specify the Shore hardness scale (e.g., 'SHORE HARDNESS- 80±5 SHORE A')."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"2 - ⌀6.6"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D8","page":1,"quote":"2 - ⌀11"}],"comment":"The holes dimensioned by D14 (⌀6.6) and D8 (⌀11) carry no tolerance or fit callout; on a clamp these are likely functional mounting or clearance holes whose fit with fasteners must be controlled. Without tolerances they default to general machining tolerances that may not suit the assembly intent. The designer should add appropriate fit or tolerance callouts to these hole dimensions." ,"recommended_correction":"Add fit or tolerance callouts to dimensions D14 and D8 to control the hole sizes for their intended function."}]}
